code_examples.section: ltm rule command LB dst tag
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

LB::dst_tag
       Set the destination tag for the current request.

SYNOPSIS
DESCRIPTION
       Set the destination tag for the current request

       LB::dst_tag 
	   Sets the destination tag for the current request. The tag can be just a string. This tag will be used as destination
       key to look up the target connection.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    LB::dst_tag "foo_tag"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-10.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
